units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:2">Tosef. Sabb. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 5:2">V</cite>), 2 <he>ויַפְשִׁיל את הרצועה תחת זנבו</he> and fasten the strap under its tail; Y. ib. V, 7ᵇ bot.; Bab.

Tosef. ib. VI (VII), 9 אל תַּפְשִׁיל ידך לאחוריך וכ׳ do not twist thy hands on thy back, lest we be prevented from work (a superstitious belief); Yalk. Lev. 587.—Esp. ה׳ לאחוריו to twist or knot a bundle and throw it over one’s shoulder.

<cite ref="Sukkah 27b:11">Succ. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>טליתו וכ׳</he> … <he>ה׳</he> R. El. tied up his cloak and threw it over his back and went off; <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 1:9">Tosef. ib. I, 9</cite> … <he>רגליו וכ׳ ה׳</he> (read <he>בגדיו</he>, v. infra) R. El. bundled up his garments &c., i.e. went off in an ostentatious manner).
<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 8:4">Tosef. Ḥull. VIII, 4</cite> [read:] <he>נותנן … ומַפְשִׁילָן לאחוריו</he> he may wrap them up with the peddler’s bundle and strike, and cast them over his shoulder.
<cite ref="Menachot 85b:16">Men. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ כליו לאחוריו</he> he tied up his implements and threw them &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:5">Kil. IX, 5</cite> Y. ed. <he>הצנועים מַפְשִׁילִין לאחוריהן במקל</he> the scrupulous carry (the garments of mixed material, <cite ref="K00674"><he>כלאים</he></cite>) in bundles over their shoulders. Y. ib. IX, beg. 31ᵈ (ref. to <he>לא יעלה</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 19:19">Lev. XIX, 19</cite>) I might have thought, <he>לא יפשיל את הקופה וכ׳</he> (not <he>לך</he>) one dare not throw the bundle (containing forbidden garments) over one’s shoulder; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 232:2">Sifré Deut. 232</cite> <he>לא יַפְשִׁילֶנּוּ בקופה וכ׳</he> (not <he>לקופה</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 614:1">Yalk. Lev. 614</cite> <he>לא יִפְשְׁלֶנּוּ בקופה וכ׳</he>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>, end; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 38:5">Yalk. ib. 38</cite> <he>ה׳ דברים לאחוריו וכ׳</he> he (Cain) threw the words (which he had heard) over his shoulder and went off, i.e. was petulant. Pesik. Shub., p. 160ᵃ <he>יצא כמפשיל דברים וכ׳</he> he went off like one that casts the words &c.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <he>ה׳ בגדיו לאחוריו</he>, v. supra.—Part. pass. <he>מוּפְשָׁל</he>; f. <he>מוּפְשֶׁלֶת</he>. Y. B. Kam. II, 3ᵃ <he>היתה קופתו מ׳ וכ׳</he> if his bundle (of grain &c.) was hanging over his back &c.

senses.gloss: to twist (wicks), (v. פְּתִילָה). Y. Succ. V, 55ᵇ bot. (expl. מפקיעין) מַפְשִׁילִים they make wicks of them, v. פָּקַע.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 75a">Keth. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>הִפְשִׁילָה דדיה וכ׳</he> she twisted her breasts back of her and gave suck to her child; a. e.
